title: Jev has a significant paired edge but misses the pre-registered absolute margin
summary: A-B=9/110=8.18 percentage points (102/110 vs 93/110). W-L=13-4=9; the exact one-sided sign tail for 13 of 17 disagreements is 0.0245209, matching p_win=0.02452. The margin gate needs at least 11 net additional correct rows at M=110, so stop (margin) precedes the significant sign-test result.

title: All 110 rows were measured; Jev reruns were unanimous by row
summary: K=M=110 is full measured coverage. F=0, under the scorer definition, means the three Jev answers agreed with their modal call on every measured row. This says nothing about label validity or corpus representativeness.

title: The baseline is a ten-word matcher over only the final 400 characters
summary: The detector tests a case-insensitive list of ten exact whole words in the trailing slice. This can miss a completion expressed with different wording or outside that slice; it can also fire on an in-tail mention without understanding subject, negation, question, or quotation. Those are mechanism-level possibilities, not row-level explanations of the ten observed misses.

title: The aggregate result does not identify what caused the ten missed labels
summary: The 010 spec records the totals, but the 110-row rows/labels and external report are unavailable in this packet. Without row-level examples or report regex.byWord counts, the exact mix of unseen synonyms, tail placement, or label error cannot be recovered; the scorer report is designed to retain row and label hashes plus missed-claim counts.

title: Feature spec cites the sentinel from a stale path
summary: Feature 026 problem text points at runtime/lib/hooks/completion-evidence-sentinel.cjs, while the scorer imports runtime/hooks/lib/completion-evidence-sentinel.cjs. The actual detector inspected is the latter. This is a documentation path mismatch; it does not show a detector behavior mismatch.
